method: Actual Chromium isolated-player checks with trusted session HTTP proxy/TLS validation. Optional analytics were returned204 by the test harness to isolate required game resources. SwiftShader is used for the post-fix Unity test; this is a test-process software renderer, not a hosted browser configuration change. No full playthrough claim.

titles.title: Block Blast

before.observed: Unity loading screen stayed up; required build data/wasm/framework were never requested.
critical_errors: Failed to read the 'serviceWorker' property from 'Navigator': Service worker is disabled because the context is sandboxed and lacks the 'allow-same-origin' flag.

source_repair: Make StreamingAssets URL explicitly point to the original game CDN. Unity resolves it against document.URL, which is about:srcdoc in the isolated player.
Register the original service worker only when it shares the current page origin; handle registration rejection. Imported copies otherwise cannot register a third-party-origin worker.
titles.shared_repair: player-compat.js (parent-owned): when the sandboxed Cache API getter throws, expose it as unavailable so Unity takes its own HTTP download fallback instead of synchronously throwing.

after.test_path: Normal current local player and shared compatibility script; no injected cache shim in this final run.
after.renderer: Chromium test process uses SwiftShader software WebGL.
after.visual_evidence: Actual colored puzzle board and tutorial, after the Unity loading overlay disappeared.

local_core_repair.visual_evidence: Actual puzzle board after the Unity intro, with outside game/CDN hosts blocked.

titles.title: Grindcraft
titles.observed: Original title screen renders; clicking Play enters the actual crafting-grid gameplay.
titles.required_resource_observation: Game JS, CMG adapter, image assets, fonts, XML data and maps returned200.
titles.page_error: Legacy analytics debug code reads window.top.location.href across the isolated frame boundary; it does not prevent the tested Play action.
titles.remaining_limit: 37 source sound MP3 requests failed404/403; matching OGG probes also404. Audio files are unavailable in the pinned original asset repository. The game was not disabled or replaced.

result: Block Blast source startup repaired and verified together with parent shared Cache API fix. Grindcraft gameplay independently verified; retained source and documented missing audio instead of disabling a functioning title.
